newsitem.title: USA: All American says to buy St. Pete Bagel.
newsitem.headline: All American says to buy St. Pete Bagel.

text.p: All American Food Group Inc said Friday it has agreed to buy St. Pete Bagel.
The closing is expected in 30-45 days. Terms of the agreement have not been disclosed.
All American said the six-store bagel chain will become a part of Goldberg's New York Bagels, its retail, franchised bagel chain subsidiary.

All American said that as part of the deal, St. Pete Bagel will also become an area developer for the company and expects to add an additional 20 to 30 stores in the Tampa/St. Petersburg, Florida market.
The company said this expansion is expected to be completed during the next three year period.
